book_pages_valid.name: book_pages_valid
book_pages_valid.value: "courses"."current_page" >= 0 and ("courses"."kind" <> 'book' or ("courses"."total_pages" is not null and "courses"."total_pages" > 0 and "courses"."current_page" <= "courses"."total_pages"))

course_practice_scope.name: course_practice_scope
course_practice_scope.value: not "exams"."is_practice" or ("exams"."session_id" is null and not "exams"."is_final")
